description: Bootstrap v3.2.0 Popover component JavaScript implementation, defining the Popover class, its methods, and plugin registration.

classes.name: Popover
classes.description: Class implementing the popover functionality, extending tooltip.js.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Returns the default options for the Popover.
